# book_object_timeslot (Resource)

The object_timeslot records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `object_id` (String) Object the timeslot is attached to.
- `object_type` (String) Type of the object the timeslot is attached to.

### Optional

- `bookable_id` (String) The key of the bookable record.
- `bookable_type_id` (String) The key of the bookable_type record.
- `conditions` (Dynamic) Conditions that gate when the timeslot binding is active.
- `location_id` (String) The key of the location record.
- `priority` (Number) Resolution priority when multiple timeslots apply to the object.
- `reason` (String) Free form note describing why the timeslot is attached.
- `timeslot_id` (String) The key of the timeslot record.
